```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Let's take a look at the Jerusalem map and find King David's ancient city!

```{r map}
library(leaflet)

my_map <- leaflet () %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addMarkers (lat=31.771782, lng=35.229341,
              popup = "King David's city"
  )

my_map
```
